name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel chart
description: A React funnel chart for conversion: bars narrow by stage and every step shows how many continued and dropped off. Animated, accessible, Tailwind v4.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Funnel chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/funnel-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { FunnelChart, FunnelTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/funnel-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
